provenance.kind: NEW RECOVERY RERUN of hash-verified original source. Not original player captures or historical result files.

result.kind: privileged goal-variation witnesses, not player evidence

newGoal.statement: During the entire exact repeating physical cycle, each living rooted grove C2/C4 needs every uninterrupted wet phase AND every uninterrupted dry phase to last at least 3 beats. Never water both simultaneously or flood either. Any construction satisfying this is valid; no named component is required.
newGoal.explanation: Run lengths are measured around the whole cycle, joining matching phases across its displayed start/end. This is a changed world goal, not an action allowance, ingredient stock, time limit, or command minimum.

recipes.effect: Hard walking surface; flow passes unchanged.
Moldable surface; strong water floods it.
Hard fired surface, no roots.
Construct chosen cardinal outgoing ports at a place.
Carry flow on chosen ports and provide an elevated dry walk.
Root soil/clay, soften water, fragment exact marks and emit seeds.
A rooted living place; roots and descendants use the same water law.
A walking structure safe in gentle water, but not strong water.
A visible sensor of water at its actual place.
A physical gate with one or two selected outlet ports.
Select dry/wet outlet from an adjacent actual float; its water changes operation.
Join an explicitly chosen closed cardinal path into actual connected channels.
Open the last edge of an existing loop; input crosses every retained route cell before reaching its output.
Combine the delay output float with its adjacent entry valve, using actual travel as feedback.
An unfired exact-record surface; strong water still floods it.
A hard exact-record surface; retains actual incoming identities.
An archive that republishes its own retained identities, never invented originals.
A rooted living transmitter: exact inputs become fragments, not retained exact copies.
